clients.description: The clients to generate, by name.

client.description: The name of the root client class. It must be a Dart class name that starts with an uppercase letter and is not a reserved word (the schema cannot check the last). When unset it is made from the client name with Client.

group.description: The template of the name of a group class. It must contain {Tag} and give a Dart identifier. Default: {Tag}Api.

default_group.description: The class of operations without a group. It is the name of a class, so a reserved word cannot be it (the schema cannot check this). Default: DefaultApi.

input_suffix.description: The suffix of the request model of a schema that is split by direction. It must differ from patch_suffix (the schema cannot check this). Default: Input.

patch_suffix.description: The suffix of the PATCH body model of a schema that is also used elsewhere. It must differ from input_suffix (the schema cannot check this). Default: Patch.

operation_prefix.description: A regular expression removed from the start of an operationId before the method name is made. It applies only where its match starts at the first character. It must be a valid regular expression (the schema cannot check this).

stream_suffix.description: The suffix of the event-stream method of an operation that also returns JSON. Letters and digits, from an uppercase letter or a digit. Default: Stream.

naming.description: How the generated classes and methods are named.

group_by.description: How operations are put into classes. Default: tag.

operations.description: Operations to match, by operationId or as METHOD /path; * matches inside one segment.

paths.description: Paths to match; * is one path segment and ** is any number.

include.description: Generate only the operations that match (a union of tags, operations and paths); empty means all.

operations.description: Operations to match, by operationId or as METHOD /path; * matches inside one segment.

paths.description: Paths to match; * is one path segment and ** is any number.

exclude.description: Leave out the operations that match; it wins.

number.description: The Dart type of a number without a format. Default: num.

type.description: The Dart type, written as it is: no prefix and no type arguments, and not a reserved word (the schema cannot check the last).

import.description: The package: or dart: library that declares the type.

converter.description: A class with fromJson and toJson that converts the type, when the type itself has no such members.

formats.description: Custom Dart types by the format of a schema.

schemas.description: Custom Dart types by the key of a component schema.

types.description: How the types of schemas are written.

tri_state.description: Which properties of PATCH bodies tell null from absent. Default: patch.

union.description: How a oneOf or anyOf without a discriminator whose variants share a JSON type is generated. Default: raw.

exhaustive.description: Whether the bases of enums, unions, status types and event unions are sealed, so a switch names every case. Default: true.

default_schema.description: The key of the component schema that is the body of an error status declared without one.

reconnect.description: Whether the event streams of GET operations reconnect unless a call says no. Default: false.

input.description: The OpenAPI file, relative to this file.

output.description: The directory the client is written to.

overrides.description: The overrides file of this client.

baseline.description: The baseline file of this client; each client has its own.

severity.description: The level of diagnostic codes, by id or by name: error, warning, info or off. A code that reports a file that cannot be read can be raised but not lowered.
